| Basic parameters   | EPO action mode                  | EPO action modes: 0- transfer to bypass; 1- transfer to UPS shutdown. The default is transfering to bypass.                      |
|--------------------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Basic parameters   | Manual bypass enable             | Set startup of manual bypass switch when maintain the UPS: 0- close; 1- open. The default is closing.                            |
| Basic parameters   | Altitude derating                | 0 ~ 6000 m (settable), 1000 m (by default)                                                                                       |
| Basic parameters   | Numbers of parallel units        | The default is 1. 1-8 is settable.                                                                                               |
| Basic parameters   | UPS number of parallel units     | The default is 1. 1-8 is settable.                                                                                               |
| Basic parameters   | Generator startup voltage        | Generator start voltage (dry contact operating voltage), the default is 550 V.                                                   |
| Basic parameters   | Generator shutdown voltage       | Generator shutdown voltage (dry contact operating voltage), the default is 600 V.                                                |
| Basic parameters   | Master control test enable       | Used in maintenance mode, shutdown by default.                                                                                   |
| Main parameters    | Rated input phase voltage        | Display according to the rated voltage of program initialization, select one from 220 / 230 / 240 or 100 / 110 / 115 / 120 / 127 |
| Main parameters    | Rated input frequency            | Rated input frequency 50 Hz / 60 Hz (optional), the default is 50 Hz.                                                            |
| Main parameters    | Rectifier delay start            | Set delayed start time of rectifier [1,300], the default is 10 s.                                                                |
| Main parameters    | Input current limit              | Set rectifier input current limit [0.1, 1.1], the default is 1.1.                                                                |
| Main parameters    | Rectifier soft start time        | The default is 10 s. 5 - 30 s is settable.                                                                                       |
| Bypass parameters  | Bypass voltage range upper limit | Bypass voltage range upper limit [10%, 15%, 20%, 25%], the default is 20%.                                                       |
| Bypass parameters  | Bypass voltage range lower limit | Bypass voltage range lower limit [10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%], the default is 20%.                                             |
| Bypass parameters  | ECO voltage upper limit          | ECO voltage upper limit range [5%, 10%, 15%], the default is 10%.                                                                |
| Bypass parameters  | ECO voltage lower limit          | ECO voltage lower limit range [5%, 10%, 15%], the default is 10%.                                                                |
